actual_original.basis: 基于供应下降的基本面，若无其他逆向消息，价格可能出现上行；但截至目前无价格反应，计价不确定。

independent_review.legitimate: Supplied actual-flow loss supports upward news pressure; valid same-contract flat baseline supports a conditional close-up forecast. Those signs are not the error.
independent_review.invalid: 但截至目前无价格反应 asserts actual absence without a post-publication reaction observation. The preceding 若无其他逆向消息 conditional ends before 但 and cannot qualify this later predicate. 计价不确定 elsewhere does not negate the assertion.
independent_review.epistemic_phrases: 缺乏价格反应 can mean missing reaction evidence; do not mechanically reject all 缺乏/未见 or weak-transmission statements.

failure_mode: Existing general observation patterns require negative causative verbs or a negative verb after the price noun. Bare 无价格反应 / 价格无反应 are not covered outside Gassco-specific scope. This actual source is a measured-flow diagnostic, not a Gassco notice.

minimal_proposal_after_run.scope: Add bare price-reaction absence predicates in existing general observation gate, sharing current source/as-of reaction support checks. Keep future physical-only causation exception separate.
preserve: 无价格反应数据/证据/观测/记录 = absence of evidence

若无价格反应则… = future condition

minimal_proposal_after_run.request_policy: No input/system/schema/weights/direction or retry-count changes. Run completes on frozen source; future actual stage required for affected paths. Original strictTrue plus independentFalse retained separately.
